animationDifferences.reference: TextSing.Run uses full ink width at the end of each wrapped strip, otherwise subtracts half of the transition width
animationDifferences.replicaInitial: LyricRow.Update used ink width times word fraction for all words
animationDifferences.currentState: WordSweep matches 108 original Run plans / 540 samples; native whole-page verification pending

animationDifferences.reference: TextWordShine.LoadWord only creates BitmapCache when EnablePlusLighter is enabled
animationDifferences.currentState: Cache is now conditional on EnablePlusLighter

animationDifferences.reference: TextSing.Stop and TextWordShine.Stop distinguish finishing the animation from immediate reset; BuggyApple can request interruption
animationDifferences.replicaInitial: LyricRow.Update reset glyph transforms when the line was no longer active
animationDifferences.currentState: iOS smooth/immediate stop and float height ported against 32 native fixtures; legacy cancellation ordering pending

edgeDefectRootCause: Missing reference padding anchor made WPF map the mask to ink bounds; endpoint pixel checks now pass. Whole-page native verification remains open.
